title.zh: 名义年利率、月利率与实际年利率
title.en: Nominal rate, periodic rate and effective annual rate

description.zh: 年利率 4% 按月计息时，每月用 0.333%，滚满一年是 4.07%：同一个利率的三个名字。
description.en: A 4% annual rate charged monthly uses 0.333% a month and compounds to 4.07% over a year: three names for one rate.

zh: 月利率怎么换算年利率

description.zh: 月供是让欠款在最后一个月正好还清的那个数：M = P·i ÷ (1 − (1 + i)^−n)。
description.en: The monthly payment is the one number that clears the balance exactly in the last month: M = P·i / (1 − (1 + i)^−n).

en: how is a mortgage payment calculated

title.zh: 还款表：为什么前几年主要还利息
title.en: The amortisation schedule: why early payments are mostly interest

description.zh: 利息按还欠着的钱算，所以前几年月供大多是利息；4%、30 年的贷款要到第 153 个月本金才超过利息。
description.en: Interest is charged on what is still owed, so early payments are mostly interest; on a 4%, 30-year loan principal overtakes interest only in month 153.

en: why are mortgage payments mostly interest

description.zh: 等额本金总利息少，只是因为平均欠得少；按贷款利率折现，两种还法都正好等于借的钱。
description.en: Equal-principal repayment costs less interest only because less is owed on average; discounted at the loan rate, both repay exactly the amount borrowed.

zh: 等额本金和等额本息哪个划算
等额本金和等额本息的区别
等额本息是不是多收利息
en: which repayment method costs less interest

title.zh: 提前还款：缩短年限还是减少月供
title.en: Prepaying: shorten the term or lower the payment

description.zh: 提前还的钱直接减本金；省多少利息取决于何时还、怎么还，但按贷款利率折现两种方式都正好减少那笔钱。
description.en: A prepayment goes straight to principal; the interest it saves depends on when and how, yet at the loan rate both options remove exactly that amount.

zh: 缩短年限还是减少月供
什么时候提前还款最好
en: how much interest does prepaying save

title.zh: 浮动利率：利率变了月供怎么变
title.en: Floating rates: what a rate change does to the payment

description.zh: 利率重定后，要么按剩余年限重算月供，要么月供不变、年限变；月供不够付利息时欠款会越还越多。
description.en: After a rate reset either the payment is recomputed over the remaining term or it stays and the term moves; if it no longer covers the interest, the balance grows.

en: what happens when mortgage rates rise

title.zh: 真实年利率：内部收益率与分期手续费
title.en: The true annual rate: IRR and flat-fee instalments

description.zh: 按原始本金收手续费的分期，真实年利率远高于表面数字（例子里 12 期约为 1.8 倍）；用内部收益率把所有现金流折平就能算出来。
description.en: An instalment plan charging a fee on the original principal costs far more than the quoted rate (about 1.8 times for the 12-month example); the internal rate of return over all its cash flows reveals it.

zh: 分期手续费换算年利率
en: true cost of an installment plan

title.zh: 通胀、实际利率与提前还贷的机会成本
title.en: Inflation, the real rate and the opportunity cost of prepaying

description.zh: 通胀让固定月供变轻；比较提前还贷和另作他用（都按名义收益算），标尺是贷款利率而不是通胀。
description.en: Inflation lightens a fixed payment; comparing prepaying with another use of the money, in nominal terms the yardstick is the loan rate, not inflation.

zh: 钱拿去理财还是还房贷
en: real value of a fixed payment

title.en: What you can work out from a loan contract

description.en: Three questions: what the periodic rate is, what fees are charged on, and what can change the schedule.

reason.zh: 第 2 章的月供按第 1 章的月利率 i = r/12 计算：余额每月乘 (1+i) 再减月供，4% 时只有 4,774.15 元恰好在第 360 个月还清。
reason.en: Chapter 2’s payment uses chapter 1’s monthly rate i = r/12: each month the balance is multiplied by (1+i) and the payment subtracted; at 4% only 4,774.15 clears it in month 360.

reason.zh: 第 3 章把第 2 章的固定月供逐月拆成利息和本金：第一个月 3,333 元利息、1,441 元本金，第 153 个月本金才超过利息。
reason.en: Chapter 3 splits chapter 2’s level payment month by month: the first month is 3,333 interest and 1,441 principal, and principal overtakes interest only in month 153.

reason.zh: 第 4 章把第 3 章的还款表和等额本金对比：等额本金少付 11.7 万利息，只因为平均欠得少；利息之比恰好等于平均余额之比。
reason.en: Chapter 4 sets chapter 3’s schedule against equal-principal: equal-principal pays 117,000 less interest only because less is owed on average; the interest ratio equals the average-balance ratio exactly.

reason.zh: 第 5 章在第 3 章的还款表上提前还 10 万：省下的利息取决于这笔钱原本还要欠多久，第 1 年还省 18.8 万，第 20 年只省 4.2 万。
reason.en: Chapter 5 prepays 100,000 on chapter 3’s schedule: the saving depends on how long the money would still have been owed, 188,000 in year 1 and 42,000 in year 20.

label.zh: 回答第 5 章留下的问题

reason.zh: 第 8 章回答第 5 章留下的问题：那 10 万不拿去还贷而拿去别处用会怎样；比较的标尺是贷款利率，收益率恰为 4% 时两者打平。
reason.en: Chapter 8 answers the question chapter 5 left open, what if the 100,000 went elsewhere instead of repaying the loan; the yardstick is the loan rate, and the two break even exactly at a 4% return.

reason.zh: 第 1 章：一年不还，第一个月的利息加进欠款，第二个月连它一起计息，这就是复利（“复利与贴现”第 1 步）；本章只看它给同一个利率起的三个名字。
reason.en: Chapter 1: with no payments, the first month’s interest joins the debt and earns interest the next month, which is compounding (step 1 of Compound Interest & Discounting); the chapter looks at the three names it gives one rate.

reason.zh: “钱是从哪里来的”第 7 章用同一笔贷款展示了每年的利息和本金；第 3 章细看本金超过利息的转折点为什么落在那里。
reason.en: Chapter 7 of Where Money Comes From used the same loan to show each year’s interest and principal; chapter 3 looks closely at where the turning point falls and why.

label.zh: 央行利率怎么传到房贷
label.en: How the policy rate reaches mortgages

reason.zh: 第 6 章只看利率变了以后月供怎么变；央行利率怎么一步步传到房贷利率，见“钱是从哪里来的”第 8 章。
reason.en: Chapter 6 looks only at what a rate change does to the payment; how the central bank’s rate passes through to mortgage rates is chapter 8 of Where Money Comes From.

reason.zh: “钱是从哪里来的”第 5 章说，物价上涨时固定利率借款人的实际负担变轻；第 8 章把它算出来：通胀 2% 时最后一期 4,774 元只值今天的 2,636 元。
reason.en: Chapter 5 of Where Money Comes From explained that rising prices lighten a fixed-rate borrower’s real burden; chapter 8 works it out: at 2% inflation the last 4,774 payment is worth 2,636 today.
